headline: Source: Packers lose DT Javon Hargrave for season to torn Achilles
summary: Tests confirmed Monday that Packers defensive tackle Javon Hargrave suffered a season-ending torn Achilles in Sunday's victory over the Bears, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

headline: Lions’ Tom Kennedy Likely To Undergo Season-Ending Knee Surgery; Devin White Suffers Broken Forearm
summary: The Lions improved to 3-2 with a 45-21 thrashing of the Cardinals on Sunday, but they did not escape Arizona unscathed. Wide receiver/returner Tom Kennedy and linebacker Devin White each went down with significant injuries in the first half. headline: Shanahan says 49ers WR Deebo Samuel to miss time with hamstring injury
summary: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel is expected to miss "at least a couple of weeks" with the hamstring injury he suffered Sunday in Seattle, coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday.

headline: Sources: Packers not anticipating Micah Parsons' return for game vs. Cowboys
summary: The Packers are not anticipating that star pass rusher Micah Parsons will return to practice this week as Green Bay prepares for Sunday night's game against the Dallas Cowboys, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

headline: Caleb Williams is "progressing" but Bears haven't determined who will start if he can't
summary: The Bears hope to have Caleb Williams back for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
